name: trinaxai-docs-golden-v1
description: Retrieval benchmark over TrinaxAI's own English documentation (20 files, many near-duplicate topics). Spanish queries test cross-lingual retrieval; the last three cases must abstain.

cases.query: How quickly does the project aim to respond to a reported security vulnerability?
Which hash algorithm do content fingerprints use for incremental indexing?
What generation speed in tokens per second did qwen2.5-coder:1.5b reach in the model benchmark?
Which environment variable lists the IPs or CIDRs allowed as transport peers for signed gateway assertions?
Who owns the TrinaxAI trademark?
Which variable sets how many seconds an empty backend rate-limit bucket takes to refill?
What happens in the release workflow if the imported public signing key fingerprint differs from the expected one?
Why must port 11434 never be exposed to the network?
What is the minimum free disk space required to install TrinaxAI on Linux?
Which PowerShell version is the minimum for installing TrinaxAI on Windows?
What is the default maximum number of unexpired web search result entries kept in memory?
Which file holds the key used to hash pairing codes and device bearer tokens?
Which commands should I run from the repository root before opening a support issue?
Which model in the benchmark was fast but mistranslated the term RAG?
¿En cuántas horas se propone responder el proyecto a un reporte de vulnerabilidad?
¿Qué velocidad en tokens por segundo obtuvo qwen3.5:2b en el benchmark de modelos?
¿Qué versión mínima de PowerShell hace falta para instalar en Windows?
